product_overview: FilmCollab is a film industry networking and collaboration platform where users can create professional profiles, discover opportunities, and manage job or casting-related postings. It also aims to support community interaction, project collaboration, and admin oversight across the platform.
core_goals: Register and sign in to access the platform
Create and maintain a professional profile
Browse and post industry job opportunities and casting calls
View dashboard insights about user activity and profile status
Connect with other film industry professionals and collaborate on opportunities

features.name: User Registration
features.description: Allows new users to create an account with their name, email, and password.
user_flows: Navigate to /signup -> Enter first and last name -> Enter email and password -> Submit the registration form -> Access the authenticated experience

features.name: User Login
features.description: Allows returning users to sign in with email and password credentials.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Enter email address -> Enter password -> Submit the sign in form -> Access the authenticated experience
Navigate to /login -> Enter email address -> Enter incorrect password -> Submit the sign in form -> See an invalid credentials message

features.name: User Dashboard
features.description: Shows account-level overview information such as application totals and profile completion status.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard -> View total jobs applied -> View profile completion status

features.name: Job Board
features.description: Lets authenticated users view existing jobs and create new job postings from the jobs board.
user_flows: Navigate to /jobs -> Open the job posting dialog -> Enter job title, company, location, type, experience, and industry -> Enter the job description -> Submit the job posting form -> See the new job appear in the jobs list
